name: application-transfer-form
title: Transfer Form
description: Transfer form with from/to account selectors, an amount field, a Now/Schedule toggle, and a date input.
useWhen: Moving money between two of the user's own accounts, or to a saved external recipient, in a banking dashboard.
You need both an immediate and a scheduled transfer path in the same form, toggled with a single control.
The from-account option should show its live balance so the user can gut-check before submitting.
avoidWhen: You're converting between currencies rather than transferring within one currency — use `currency-converter` for that unrelated case.
There's no scheduling need — drop the Now/Schedule toggle and the date field entirely rather than disabling them.
Recipients are managed elsewhere (payee list, address book) — link out to that flow instead of inlining a third account selector here.
responsiveBehavior: Single-column form at a fixed max width; the Now/Schedule toggle stays a fixed 2-column grid at any form width.
accessibility: From/To selects are real <select> elements with associated <label for>, not custom listboxes, so they work with native keyboard and screen-reader support.
The Now/Schedule choice uses a radio fieldset with a visible <legend>, not a div-based tab pattern, preserving native grouped-choice semantics.
The date input is only meaningfully actionable when Schedule is selected; it remains present (not conditionally unmounted) so its state persists across toggling.

variants.title: Transfer Form
variants.description: From Everyday Checking to High-Yield Savings, $250.00, Now/Schedule toggle, and a date field.
accessibility: The selected When option is reflected with both a filled background and a border change, not color alone.

variants.description: Transfer form adapted for dark surfaces.
